messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: PD incident INC-8492 - routing-proxy high p95 latency spike. Auto-page to #eng-oncall fired.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-8492 escalated to on-call (1).
alex: acked. Looking now. Can someone drop the initial query that triggered?
mira: on it. seeing a series of 5xxs from router-frontend -> backend-proxy. spikes around 11:07 UTC.
jamal: graph looks like connection timeouts to KV cache, retries flooding router. Could be a cache warmup.
alex: thanks. mirroring logs:
```
router | 2026-03-15T11:07:21Z WARN request failed id=abcd status=504 backend=kv-cache err="connection reset"
router | 2026-03-15T11:07:22Z INFO retrying id=abcd attempt=2
```
mira: confirmed a recent deploy to kv-cache cluster-3 ~11:05. autoscaling might have spun new pods with cold connections.
sre-lead: alex, if this is cache warmup we should open temporary fallback to stale reads and lower retry attempts. Can you scope impact?
alex: quick check on error budget: internal traces show ~0.7% of requests got 504s in the last 3m, user-facing latencies rose p95 from 90ms -> 450ms. No uptick in customer-facing error pages on dashboards.
jamal: contacting infra to check cluster-3 node health, but I can drop retry multiplier from 5 -> 2 in router config for warm window. Would that help?
mira: +1. Lower retries should reduce amplification.
alex: I'll kick a quick config apply to router canary (route=staging) then to prod if green. Applying now.
incident-bot: action logged: alex executed runbook step "reduce-router-retries" (change-id: rtr-1221).
jarvis (infra-bot): node-check cluster-3: 2/5 nodes showing high conn-reset counts, but CPU/mem normal.
jamal: infra confirms two nodes recycled during deploy and are finishing TCP backlog. Rolling restart might clear. I'll coordinate with infra to RRY them out of rotation.
alex: canary looked good, pushing to prod.
mir a: after push p95 back to ~120ms after 40s. Errors dropping.
pagerduty: INC-8492 acknowledged by alex.
sre-lead: nice mitigation. estimate customer impact: limited, short window, no reported customer tickets yet. mark severity P2 and monitor 30m.
jamal: infra finished draining/replacing nodes, connection reset counts returning to baseline.
incident-bot: INC-8492 has been auto-resolved by monitoring (no alerts for 5m).
alex: closing the pager. leaving a brief note for post-incident: root cause likely deploy-caused connection backlog in cache cluster; ramped retries + cold peers amplified visible latency. Recommend: (1) add deploy-time connection warm-up/gentle ramp, (2) add circuit breaker for cache retries to avoid amplification, (3) tweak alert thresholds to correlate error-type (504 vs 5xx) to reduce noise.
mira: +1 to circuit breaker. Also propose a short-runbook tweak: auto-detect recent deploys and relax retry multiplier.
sre-lead: please file follow-ups in the oncall backlog. Good incident handling.
jamal: filing infra ticket to add graceful drain hooks to cache nodes: INFRA-2751.
alex: thanks all. ending thread. :white_check_mark:
